chunks: Jarir narrated from Al-Ash'ath ibn Mas'ood from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family)
He said: The Caliphs after me will be twelve, in number like the chiefs of the Children of Israel.
ai.seo_question: How many Caliphs or Imams will there be after the Prophet according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *al-Khisal*, establishes the number of the Twelve Imams by drawing a parallel to the twelve tribes of Israel, a motif also found in Sunni sources like the *Musnad* of Ahmad. The reference to 'nucleba' (chiefs/leaders) underscores their role as divinely appointed guides, reinforcing the Shia doctrine of *Ismah* (infallibility) and the continuity of leadership after the Prophet. It serves as a foundational textual proof (*hujjah*) for the specific count of Imams, distinguishing Shia belief from other sects.
